name: ASUS Aura mice (direct mode)
description: Per-zone lighting of the ASUS ROG mice with a native direct mode: Gladius III Wireless AimPoint, Chakram X, Spatha X, Strix Impact III, Keris Wireless AimPoint (wired and 2.4 GHz). Adapted from OpenRGB's AsusAuraMouseController (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. The older Aura mice without a direct mode are not claimed. The save command, hardware modes, DPI and polling rate are never touched. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/asus-aura-mouse.md.
